Class MiteInfestation

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.simulation.diseases.MiteInfestation
All Implemented Interfaces:
Disease
public class MiteInfestation extends Object implements Disease
Parasitic mite infestation (e.g., Varroa-like). Common in honeybees but adapted for ant simulation. Weakens individuals and spreads through contact.

Effects:

  • Slowly drains energy and health
  • Reduces work efficiency
  • Spreads easily through colony contact
  • Can be groomed off by nestmates
